form.label: Framework Governance
form.description: Review framework provenance, mapping boundaries, and the evidence required before a framework can support an authoritative audit conclusion.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected_value=tostring(coalesce(selected,default_selected)), selected=if(selected_value="1" OR selected_value="true",1,0) | search status=active selected=1 | fields framework_key framework_name

div.span: Framework: limits the governance review to selected framework content. i
Mapping status: provisional means usable for navigation and roll-up only, not authoritative equivalence. i

div.h1: Know what the framework content proves
div.p: This page separates framework provenance and mapping approval from implementation status. A framework can be selected for navigation while its mappings remain provisional.

html.div: Governance rule: “Approved for roll-up” supports navigation and grouped posture views only. It does not approve a one-to-one control mapping, prove implementation, or certify an organization. A named framework SME must approve source identifiers, assessment granularity, applicability, and the verification method before changing mapping status.
